# Argument

Therefore every element in it is at least `x` indices away from index `i`. Inserting `nums[i-x]` before querying is exactly the right order, as in my line `bisect.insort(sorted_window, nums[i - x])`. Then `bisect_left` finds the nearest value in the sorted window; checking both `sorted_window[pos]` and `sorted_window[pos-1]` covers the closest value on either side.
